subject: Small engagements — PO thresholds, evidence checklist, next steps
messages:
From: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@clearwave.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.io
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirement for 8-week pilot (ClearWave)

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — thanks again for the demo last week. We’d like to stand up an 8-week pilot of Redwood for a single internal team (estimated spend ~$1,800). Our procurement team asks whether a formal Purchase Order is required before you can start billing.

Can you confirm Redwood’s policy for pilots at this dollar band and, if you allow a waiver, what documentation you need from us? We’re trying to avoid delays but need to keep our audit trail intact.

Thanks —
Ellie
Ellie Harper
Head of Strategic Programs
ClearWave Analytics

---
Attachment: ClearWave_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 132 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@clearwave.io>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, procurement@clearwave.io
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirement for 8-week pilot (ClearWave)

Hi Ellie — great to hear you want to move forward. Short answer: we can support pilots without a formal PO for engagements under $2,500 with an approved PO-waiver form and minimal evidence.

Proposed path (quick):
- ClearWave signs the attached PO-Waiver-Form.xlsx and returns it to us.
- We need the SOW (which you already attached) and either an email from your procurement approver or a single-signature PDF from your finance owner.
- Redwood will issue invoices net 30 against the waived engagement and tag them with a temporary internal cost center — we’ll reconcile to a formal PO if/when you convert to a paid contract.

Policy notes:
- Threshold: <= $2,500 for pilot/no-PO route.
- Evidence: completed waiver form + SOW + procurement approver acknowledgment.
- Auditability: we retain the waiver and correspondence in our vendor onboarding record.

I’ve CC’d Grace (finance gating) and Marcus (accounting) to confirm the internal steps on our side and the temporary accounting treatment. Next steps if that works: you return the waiver and we send a DocuSign link for the SOW signature so we can schedule capacity.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: PO-Waiver-Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 24 KB)

From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@clearwave.io>, procurement@clearwave.io
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirement for 8-week pilot (ClearWave)

Thanks Marissa — this is fine from a finance gating perspective with one clarification.

Request: For any waiver under $2,500 we need the following completed before we mark the vendor record as "waived":
- PO-Waiver-Form completed (reason code + approver name + approver email)
- SOW with scope and cost line items (already provided)
- Procurement approver confirmation (email thread or signed note)
- Cost center to charge (please provide a Redwood internal cost center or we’ll use the default Partnerships trial code)

If ClearWave can provide the approver confirmation, finance will accept the waiver and mark the invoices as trial spend (non-capital). Marcus — can you confirm the temporary GL string we should use and whether this needs to route to accounting for a separate journal entry?

Happy to approve as soon as those pieces are in place.

Grace Oconnor
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
